answer: Simultaneous bandwidth checks: at one random instant each epoch, the network asks every agent to stream 50 MB of data derived from its own address within ten seconds. A reef of a thousand sybils behind one uplink is a narrow bridge, so most of them time out together and forfeit that epoch's reward. To pass, an attacker must buy a separate fast connection for every fake identity, turning a cheap jade trinket of spare processes into a real monthly bill per account.
